versions.content: Needed libraries Type: valid Description: It SHALL be possible to describe which libraries (vendor and version) have been used for object code deliveries or which need to be included for source code deliveries. Rationale: When a BSW module is delivered as object code the integrator needs to know how the object code has to be integrated. If it is delivered as source code, the code may need a specific version of expected libraries only. Dependencies:  Use Case: If several BSW modules use the same library it only needs to be present on the ECU once. Describe the used libraries and version in order to be able to detect whether the libraries used by several BSW module implementations are not compatible. 5 18 of 47  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 86: AUTOSAR_RS_BSWModuleDescriptionTemplate Requirements on Basic Software Module Description Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Supporting Material: 
